title: Bunko Punch
description: This slushy mix of tea, citrus juices, grapefruit soda, and vodka will keep the conversation merry at your next card game. It needs to chill overnight to get really cold.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1 (6 ounce) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (2 liter) bottle grapefruit flavored soda, chilled

steps.text: Mix together the tea, water, vodka, orange juice concentrate, and pink lemonade concentrate in a large freezer-proof bowl, such as glass or stainless steel, and freeze overnight or several days ahead. With a fork, scrape the frozen mixture into a slush; pour the grapefruit soda into the slushy mixture, and stir. Keep cold in an ice chest.
